items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: Jimmy Maloney of Jimmy George, who played the two clarinets.

ctx.x: Jimmy Maloney of Jimmy George, who played the two clarinets. Yeah. So beautifully together. Played them together and, and, and, real good. And I knew a guy in New Orleans who was with the, uh, Tom Guerin band who played three clarinets at one time.
